triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.note: Spec section 1: policy-owned assertion envelope, exact GREEN predicate, and the gate-consumption query contract (W2/W3 boundary).
Spec section 2: runner pre/post four-tuple invariance (head/material/index/status) in a disposable workspace.
Spec section 3: supersedes-chain integrity (monotonic seq + prior digest + fork rejection, unique chain head) plus idempotency key.
Spec section 4: quarantine/recover owner-gated operations, corrected retention claims, and the legacy-record posture.
Gate-consumption query contract section: precise read-only query + edge-state answers + W2/W3 boundary MUST NOT list.
Legacy record posture section: one normative decision + in-flight transition rule + downgrade-loophole closure.

note: Acceptance bindings for the red-evidence-subsystem-spec deliverable; each binding covers one spec section against its CHK verificationIntent lanes. Acceptance claim defaults to the original intent snapshot claim. AB-005/006 added for the scope-review gaps.
